findings.claim: The calibration reports language-format adherence rising from 48/38/75% to 100% across three agents and zero prose lines over 167 subsequent turns, but two interventions occurred four minutes apart, so the causal contribution of fixed prompt-head retrieval versus repeated XENO reminder was not isolated.
findings.implication: Preserve the measurement battery and rerun factorized ablations; do not attribute the gain to either intervention without isolation.

findings.claim: A cache/header effort consumed about 25 minutes, four tools and eleven checks while measured hit rate moved only 98.1% to 98.3%; the report explicitly identifies the mistake as confusing mechanism correctness with useful effect.
findings.implication: Require baseline-before-build and effect-size gates for token/context optimizations; a byte-identical mechanism is not evidence of useful impact.

findings.claim: The report identifies output volume as the dominant measured cost, citing about 1.45 million output tokens across three helpers in one day; post-change per-turn output fell 27-52% across three agents but task mix changed, so causal attribution remained open.
findings.implication: Track output-token cost and task-matched quality jointly; do not optimize cache/input mechanisms while ignoring output generation cost.

findings.claim: The report says requested rules repeatedly failed while counted/blocked invariants held, and three watcher false alarms came from matching patterns across whole text instead of command position.
findings.implication: Convert critical format/safety constraints into deterministic validators at the correct syntactic boundary and measure false-positive burden; instruction-only compliance is not an invariant.

findings.claim: A high system load initially blamed on FRANK was re-attributed after measurement to two test browsers at 489% and 548% CPU plus FRANK UI at 56%; reported load average fell from 9.49 peak to 1.18 after correction.
findings.implication: Performance attribution must separate system/self/external-process load before architecture blame or optimization.

earned_work.reason: High-value measurement/test-oracle lineage, but current RAE already contains overlapping throughput, context and enforcement research; unique avoided-hour credit requires later ancestry deduplication.
